en: Dependent on a mental wholesome state, a non-mental non-wholesome state arises by way of root condition... Three [results] under root condition... up to ... three under non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on a mental unwholesome state, a non-mental non-unwholesome state arises by way of root condition... Three [results] under root condition... up to ... three under non-disappearance condition.

Conditioned by a non-mental indeterminate state, a non-non-mental non-indeterminate state arises by way of root condition... Three [results] under root condition... up to ... three under non-disappearance condition.
